version: Home Auth Error Consistency Audit G2-r26

accepted_examples.change: Current progressive identifier-required state, inline message before method hint; replaces obsolete combined-form state usage.
Required password in explicit email/password alternative; no new-password minimum enforced on Login.
Move rejected-code reason into six-slot field group; remove separate box, retain clearing/focus policy.
Inline expiry status at code field, retain disabled slots/explicit request-new; no invented expiry duration.
Fill missing email-required visual with error at recovery email input; neutral account acknowledgement unchanged.
Fill short-new-password and confirmation-mismatch visual using accepted minimum8/matching rules, no summary box.
Adapt invalid OTP to signup email-verification purpose with inline reason and retained use-first action; Google excluded.
Carry selected C form-level position to current password alternative and state pair rejection clearly; do not falsely target email/password individually.

accepted_scope: The eight error examples shown in the audit overview: current Login identifier/password, invalid/expired Login OTP, required recovery email, short/mismatched new password, invalid signup-verification OTP and rejected credential pair.
Known field errors identify the cause under the affected input or six-slot OTP group; no duplicate field-error summary before the primary action.
A rejected credential pair uses the existing form-level C position without falsely identifying a specific wrong field; known provider/service failures remain separate.
Retain previously accepted behavior, current progressive method choices and all historical evidence.
review_boundary: Acceptance is for the displayed audit examples, not blanket acceptance of all related full-form anatomy, Auth states or whole G2.
